annotation.title_clean: 关于印发儿童青少年“五健”促进行动计划（2026—2030年）的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice on Issuing the Action Plan for Promoting the "Five Health" of Children and Adolescents (2026–2030)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国家卫生健康委、国家疾控局等13部门 (National Health Commission and 12 other bodies)
annotation.summary_en: Chinese national action plan issued by 13 departments for 2026–2030, targeting child and adolescent obesity, myopia, mental health, spinal curvature and dental caries through screening, school-health collaboration, and services. Unrelated to AI or robotics, apart from a passing mention of exploring digital-intelligence technologies for health assessment.
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets 2030 targets: 60%+ students meet fitness standards, myopia rate reductions, 100% schools with mental health teachers
Requires regular school screening for vision, spinal curvature, oral health and weight
Mandates at least 2 hours of daily physical activity in schools
Uses existing public health funds and calls for exploring digital-intelligence technologies for health assessment
